notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Settle Beyond Reality.
description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
